description: Track what is trading on decentralised exchanges with DEX Screener's free public data, across a hundred-odd blockchains. Search for a token by name, price thirty at once, open a single pool, list every pool a token trades in, and follow the new token profiles, boosts, community takeovers, ads and trending narratives. Any dexscreener.com link can be pasted in place of a chain and an address, and every result comes back with one. No account or API key is required.
